meta.consensus_asof: 2026-08-24 public S&P Global snapshot; price-target refresh through 2026-08-24

economic_definition: Power-first AI/HPC digital infrastructure developer/owner/operator transitioning from bitcoin mining; value is determined by converting contracted MW into rent-producing capacity after capex, financing, dilution and governance leakage.

Fluidstack.google_backstop: Commencement-gated recognition agreement; default/insolvency after notice gives Google termination-fee or rent-pay-and-assume options.

Anthropic.credit_support: investment-grade support expected; exact guarantor/economics PRIMARY_SOURCE_CEILING

ceilings: Exact contract-level pass-through and full rent schedules unavailable for some leases.

dilution.method: Debt principal remains debt; add warrants/RSUs and only convertible excess-share leakage above capped-call protection / conversion threshold. No double count.

promise_delivery.outcome: First revenue began July 2025; remaining Core42 leases commenced Q1 2026
CB3 delivered early July 2026; total revenue-generating critical IT 102MW

competition.customer_job: Deliver operational, high-density critical IT MW on schedule with bankable power and financing.
competition.comparison_boundary: Scope, land, power, tenant equipment and site conditions differ; figures are anchors, not apples-to-apples proof.

consensus.revision_trend: Post-Q2 targets remain bullish but several high targets were cut; public target dispersion is very wide.
consensus.boundary: Full FY2028 broker model and real-time institutional positioning PRIMARY_SOURCE_CEILING.

valuation.historical_multiple_band: PRIMARY_SOURCE_CEILING due 2025-26 business-model break; peer/asset band substituted. Mature DLR/EQIX trade around high-20s LTM EV/EBITDA, but WULF scenarios deliberately use 9.5x-15x stabilized site EBITDA to reflect construction, funding and concentration risk.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.operating_world: Lake Mariner ramp 지연, Justified 일정/자본비용 악화, 미계약 pipeline 거의 무가치

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.operating_world: Lake Mariner 대부분 정상화, Justified 2028 ramp, pipeline에는 제한적 확률가치만 부여

scenarios.name: Bull Execution
scenarios.operating_world: 839MW 계약자산의 높은 완공률과 우호적 site economics, 추가 signing 일부 성공

scenarios.name: Bull Ecosystem
scenarios.operating_world: 250–500MW/년 신규 계약이 반복되고 Muskie/Hawkeye 등 전력 옵션이 계약자산으로 승격

valuation.no_double_count_rule: Warrants/RSUs/convert excess shares are in denominator and not subtracted again as monetary drag.

reverse_expectations.operating_interpretation: At current price a 12–15% 3-year return requires roughly Base-to-above-Base execution: Lake Mariner largely on schedule and meaningful Justified delivery. Current price does not require full 2.9GW pipeline value, but it is not pricing a major contracted-build failure.

stance.rule: Expected IRR ~16.0% is just above the top of the default 10–15% hurdle and U/D ~2.52x; therefore active interest is consistent, but preferred entry is lower because Base execution is already required at current price.

kpis.name: Revenue-generating critical IT MW
kpis.green: CB4/CB5 phased delivery remains on disclosed schedule; steady quarterly step-up
kpis.yellow: one-quarter slippage or customer fit-out changes without rent compensation

kpis.name: WULF Compute project cost / critical IT MW
kpis.green: ≤$10M/MW or overrun fully compensated by rent/scope

kpis.name: New critical IT lease signings
kpis.green: ≥250MW over trailing 12 months with bankable credit
kpis.red: no meaningful signing plus construction delay

kpis.name: Justified delivery
kpis.red: material delay, financing gap, or credit-support deterioration

kpis.name: Basic-share growth / equity funding
kpis.green: ≤5% annual basic share growth unless per-share contracted value rises faster

kpis.name: Funding coverage
kpis.green: contracted build equity and debt funding remain committed with no near-term gap
kpis.red: unfunded contracted capex / covenant or refinancing stress

catalysts.sensitivity: High — validates 336MW construction ramp and cash-revenue conversion
High — upgrades pipeline option to Execution only if credit/funding are bankable
High — Lake Mariner contracted ramp completion

catalysts.event: Justified construction + financing evidence ahead of Anthropic initial delivery

catalysts.sensitivity: Very High — unlocks the largest contracted engine

pre_mortem.failure: Contracted MW is real but construction/tenant timing slips repeatedly

pre_mortem.early_sign: large equity issuance, warrants, converts, high SBC
pre_mortem.watch: economic diluted shares, funding gap, interest and trust leakage

pre_mortem.failure: Power pipeline fails to become bankable tenant contracts
pre_mortem.watch: signed MW with investment-grade support, project financing

red_team.base_rate: PRIMARY_SOURCE_CEILING — the cohort of former crypto miners transformed into multi-hundred-MW hyperscale AI landlords is too young for a stable historical success rate. Scenario probabilities therefore intentionally keep Bear at 25% and Bull Ecosystem at only 10%.
false_conservatism: Uncontracted power sites could be worth materially more if hyperscaler time-to-power scarcity persists.
WULF may replicate Google-backed financing faster than modeled, reducing equity funding needs and raising per-share value.
